filterBasis: The authors' high-quality open clusters (Type o, astrometric SNR CST > 5, CMD class > 0.5), younger than 100 Myr (logAge50 < 8): young clusters have not drifted far from the arms they formed in. The age cut is a presentation choice, kept because this layer follows the arms (see source/tracers/merge.json).

frame.converter: Astropy SkyCoord Galactic to ICRS, heliocentric Cartesian

meaning: Young open clusters from Hunt & Reffert (2023), each at its median maximum-likelihood distance (dist50) from Gaia DR3 parallaxes.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the blue-white of young clusters' brightest stars.
